implementation: The Series CPU path validates every range and the optional workspace before clearing caller-owned memory. A call with zero ranges succeeds. Nonempty requests for GPU-assisted clearing are unsupported.

control.loader: The original packaged Series DLL and the TuxBox provider ran the same exports guest under Proton Experimental. The Xbox One control tested its original export set.
control.expected_cleared_byte_intervals: [16, 64) and [96, 112); all other bytes retain the 0xa5 sentinel.
control.validation: A null array for a nonempty list, unaligned start or size in the second range, and each invalid workspace field produced E_INVALIDARG. Validation failures left all 128 bytes intact.
control.optional_workspace: The same buffer was refilled with 0x4d; flags 0x81 and a null workspace cleared only bytes [16, 48).
control.translated_gpu_mode: A nonempty, otherwise valid request with flags 0 returned E_NOTIMPL and preserved all 128 sentinel bytes.
